facts.fact: Insider Intelligence projects 179.6 million monthly gamers in the US in 2022 (third-party estimate cited by the vendor).
facts.quote: There will be [179.6 million monthly gamers](https://www.insiderintelligence.com/insights/us-gaming-industry-ecosystem/) in the US this year

facts.fact: StackAdapt states that more than half of the US population is expected to identify as digital gamers by the end of 2022.
facts.quote: meaning more than half of the US population will identify as digital gamers by the end of 2022

facts.fact: A 2021 study cited by StackAdapt found that 55% of US gamers identified as male.
facts.quote: showed that 55% of gamers identified as male, and 45% identified as female

facts.fact: According to Anzu research cited by StackAdapt, 51% of gamers advise others.
facts.quote: 51% of gamers advise others and 47% influence others

facts.fact: According to Anzu research cited by StackAdapt, 46% of gamers try to be the first to know about new things such as emerging tech and new fashion.
facts.quote: 46% try to be the first to know about new stuff, like emerging tech and new fashion

facts.fact: A Fullscreen study cited by StackAdapt reports that gamers who play 10+ hours a week have 2x more disposable income than non-gamers.
facts.quote: those who play 10+ hours a week have [2x](https://www.tubefilter.com/2018/10/02/fullscreen-study-discretionary-income-gamers/) more disposable income than non-gamers

facts.fact: StackAdapt states that call-to-action text in blended in-game display ads cannot be clickable.
facts.quote: Note that CTAs cannot be clickable, so be sure to communicate concisely to the user how they can engage with your brand further.

facts.fact: The StackAdapt blog post on advertising in video games was published on August 25, 2022.
